Description: $TSLA** - TESLA STOCK FORECAST: BAIRD PREVIEWS 2026**  Baird expects Tesla to enter 2026 with multiple catalysts  maintaining an Outperform rating and a $548 price target. Description: YUAN BREAKS 7-PER-DOLLAR MARK  SIGNALING POLICY SHIFT  China’s central bank set the yuan’s daily fixing below 7 per dollar for the first time in over two years  signaling greater tolerance for currency appreciation. The People’s Bank of China fixed the rate at 6.9929  stronger than the previous session’s 7.0019.  A firmer yuan helps ease trade tensions and boosts the appeal of Chinese assets. Authorities have raised the fixing in seven of the past eight months  reinforcing the signal.  Analysts say the move shows policymakers are comfortable with further gains  especially amid a weaker dollar. The yuan has risen about 1% over the past month and could strengthen toward 6.9 in the near term  supported by strong trade surpluses  capital inflows  and improving market sentiment.
new_summary: The yuan has strengthened beyond the 7-per-dollar mark for the first time in over two years, indicating a potential policy shift by China's central bank to allow currency appreciation. This move is bolstered by increased trade surpluses and capital inflows, suggesting improved market sentiment.
